Sr. Test Automation Engineer (f/m/d) at an established IT-Security Company

Join us as a Senior Test Automation Engineer and be the driving force behind a flawless software. Rapidly develop cutting-edge automation tests to elevate our test coverage, ensuring no regression slips through with every new feature release. Measure and enhance our software's performance regularly, and be the guardian of quality and excellence our customers deserve. Your expertise will be crucial in delivering robust, reliable solutions.

- Design, develop, and execute cutting-edge automated software tests, complete with error analysis, assessments, and detailed documentation

- Identify, report, and track defects, working hand-in-hand with development teams for swift resolution
- Generate clear and insightful test reports, metrics, and documentation to keep stakeholders informed and up-to-date
- Stay ahead of the curve with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in test automation and quality assurance

Qualifications

- Proven experience (min 5 years) as a Software Test Engineer in an agile software development environment
- Excellent skills in ISTQB test specification methods and management, ideally certified
- Strong experience in test automation methods with advanced techniques
- Knowledge of Selenium, Cucumber, and Playwright testing frameworks
- First hands-on experience working with Docker for containerization
- Proficiency in Java and JavaScript, familiarity with Linux and shell scripting
- You have an open and clear communication style and excellent English skills

Nice to have

- Hands-on experience with test documentation tools like TestRail
- Experience with mobile testing using Appium
- Good German language skills

Our offer

- Mobility: free Germany-wide public transport ticket, bike leasing, or parking

- Urban Sports Club membership for flexible fitness and wellness
- Office perks: rooftop terraces & green courtyard, organic fruit and drinks, personal packages accepted at the office

- International team: 120+ colleagues from 30+ countries, open and collaborative culture

CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

LEARN MORE:

www.joycenterfamily.com [https://www.joycenterfamily.com/]

• Development of FPGA/SoC-based digital designs for the control and readout of complex, robust laser systems
• Ownership of the full FPGA/SoC development lifecycle: from requirements definition and system architecture through RTL implementation, simulation and prototyping to a qualified product

Why us?

About usMenlo Systems is a high-tech company that develops, manufactures and sells lasers and laser systems for precision applications in research and industry. Menlo Systems is one of the market leaders in the field of optical precision measurements with light and lasers based on the Nobel Prize-winning frequency comb technology. The company is headquartered in Martinsried, near Munich, Germany.

ABOUT THE ROLEERC System develops uncrewed aircraft for certified operation, in a regulatory landscape that is still being written. This role is our presence in the standardisation bodies and industry associations where that landscape takes shape — EUROCAE, GAMA, UAVDACH and BDLI among them — in the working groups drafting the certification specifications, AMC, MOC and supporting standards our aircraft will be measured against. You bring our position into those rooms while the text is still open, and you bring back what it means for us. Inside the company you turn the evolving framework into the certification basis our programmes build against, take part in the exchange with the certification authorities, and support the airworthiness team on compliance work.
WHAT YOU WILL DO● Represent ERC in the associations and standardisation bodies shaping UAS certification standards ● Work inside the drafting groups: comment on drafts, defend positions and follow them through the process ● Track rulemaking and standardisation, and assess early what they mean for our approval route ● Build ERC positions on draft material with engineering, and turn them into written contributions ● Derive and maintain the certification basis for our programmes ● Take part in the exchange with the certification authorities and prepare the input that goes with it ● Support airworthiness on means of compliance and evidence, and flag external changes early

WHAT YOU BRING● Deep, hands-on experience in aviation certification, gained in aircraft or UAS programmes ● Command of the European UAS regulatory system and the derivation of a certification basis ● Experience working in industry associations, standardisation bodies or rulemaking groups ● Comfort in committee settings, where influence comes from preparation rather than authority ● Enough engineering depth to support means of compliance, not only the regulatory argument ● A technical degree in aerospace engineering or a comparable field ● Fluent English, and German at working proficiency for committee and authority work Moreover, it would be helpful if you also ● have worked in an SC Light-UAS or Design Verification Report context ● bring EASA Compliance Verification Engineer experience ● know the military side too, such as STANAG 4671 ● bring an existing network in the European UAS standardisation and association landscape ● bring experience with ARP4754B and ARP4761A

WHAT WEC OFFER● Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides ● A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn ● Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution ● Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation ● Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen ● Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.
